pairs.title: The PR picture: a module map → the story of the change
pairs.caption: Thick arrows are the new path, dotted the path removed, a diamond per fork — the reader sees what changed before reading a word. From `scripts/ship.sh checkbody`.

before.label: the fan-in map 8 of 11 PRs drew
before.source:
flowchart LR
  E[earnings calendar] --> P[position-event.ts]
  M[market events] --> P
  P --> T[Next event column]
  P --> C[Earnings chip]
  P --> D[decision clocks]

after.label: the delta grammar
after.source:
flowchart TD
  body["PR body"] -.-> list["type allowlist"]
  body ==> parse["parse under Mermaid 11.17.2"]
  parse ==> ok{"parses?"}
  ok ==>|yes| draws["GitHub draws it"]
  ok ==>|no| stop["push refused — line named"]

pairs.title: Branch mechanics: a ledger table → the gitGraph that is the argument
pairs.caption: Same platter, drawn as what `ship.sh` does: one integration branch, one commit per item, one merge commit — so a bad item still reverts alone.

before.label: the ledger
before.source:
| # | item | evidence | revert |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | fix commitlint | verify green 12:51Z | `b0a4c8a` |
| 2 | pin flyctl | verify green 12:52Z | `9d3bfb8` |
